description: Story Agent Diversity Improvement - Implement tracking and enforcement system to reduce story element repetition and increase creative variety

userStories.title: Add database schema for story elements tracking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables to store story elements, sessions, and diversity scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Create story_elements table with columns: id, story_id, session_id, element_type, element_text, embedding_vector (JSONB or vector type), created_at
Create user_sessions table with columns: id, session_token, user_id, created_at, expires_at
Create story_diversity_scores table with columns: id, story_id, diversity_score, novel_element_count, created_at
Add indexes: story_elements(session_id, created_at), story_elements(story_id), user_sessions(session_token)
Generate and run migration successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created comprehensive database schema with all required tables, indexes, RLS policies, and helper functions. Migration file: sql/create_story_diversity_tables.sql. Documentation updated in database_schema.md.

userStories.title: Create story element extraction service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that uses LLM to extract characters, settings, objects, and plot patterns from story text.
acceptanceCriteria: Create extractStoryElements function that takes story text and returns structured JSON
Extraction uses LLM with structured output prompt (characters, settings, objects, plot_patterns)
Elements are normalized: lowercase, singular form where applicable
Returns format: {characters: [{name, type, role}], settings: [{location, environment}], objects: [{name, magical, purpose}], plot_patterns: [{action, discovery_type}]}
Function handles LLM API errors gracefully with fallback/retry logic
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created storyElementExtractionService with LLM-based extraction using GPT-4 Turbo. Implements structured output prompting, element normalization (lowercase, singular), exponential backoff retry logic (3 attempts), and fallback regex extraction. Comprehensive test suite with 20 passing tests. Files: src/services/storyElementExtractionService.ts, src/__tests__/services/storyElementExtractionService.test.ts

userStories.title: Implement embedding generation service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that generates embeddings for story elements using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small.
acceptanceCriteria: Create generateEmbedding function that takes element text and returns embedding vector
Uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small API
Returns embedding as array of numbers
Function handles API errors with retry logic
Embeddings are cached to avoid redundant API calls for identical text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created embeddingGenerationService with OpenAI text-embedding-3-small integration (1536-dimensional embeddings). Implements LRU in-memory caching (1000 entry limit), exponential backoff retry logic (3 attempts with 1s/2s/4s delays), text normalization (lowercase/trim), batch generation support, and comprehensive error handling (no retry on auth/data validation errors). Test suite: 21 passing tests covering all features and edge cases. Files: src/services/embeddingGenerationService.ts (439 lines), src/__tests__/services/embeddingGenerationService.test.ts (575 lines).

userStories.title: Create cosine similarity calculation function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a function to calculate semantic similarity between embeddings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create calculateCosineSimilarity function that takes two embedding vectors and returns similarity score (0-1)
Function correctly implements cosine similarity formula: dot(A,B) / (norm(A) * norm(B))
Returns 1.0 for identical vectors, 0.0 for orthogonal vectors
Handles edge cases: zero vectors, different length vectors
Includes unit tests with known vector pairs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created cosineSimilarityService with calculateCosineSimilarity function implementing the cosine similarity formula. Includes helper functions: findMostSimilarVector, batchCalculateSimilarity, areSimilar. Comprehensive test suite with 40 passing tests covering identical/orthogonal/opposite vectors, edge cases (zero vectors, dimension mismatches, floating-point precision), mathematical properties (commutativity, scale-invariance), and batch operations. Files: src/services/cosineSimilarityService.ts (226 lines), src/__tests__/services/cosineSimilarityService.test.ts (391 lines).

userStories.title: Implement user session management
userStories.description: As a user, my story diversity tracking should be scoped to my session.
acceptanceCriteria: Create getOrCreateSession function that retrieves or creates session from cookie/auth token
Session ID is stored in HTTP-only cookie with 24-hour expiration
Function creates new session record in user_sessions table if needed
Session expiration is enforced: expired sessions return new session ID
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created diversitySessionService with getOrCreateSession, validateSession, getCurrentSessionToken, clearSession, and getOrCreateSessionWithAuth functions. Uses AsyncStorage (React Native compatible) instead of HTTP cookies. Supports both authenticated and anonymous users. 24-hour expiration enforced at database level. Comprehensive test suite with 20 passing tests covering all scenarios. Files: src/services/diversitySessionService.ts (242 lines), src/__tests__/services/diversitySessionService.test.ts (510 lines).

userStories.title: Create recent elements retrieval service
userStories.description: As a system, I need to retrieve recent story elements for a user session to detect repetition.
acceptanceCriteria: Create getRecentElements function that takes session_id and limit (default 10) and returns recent elements
Query retrieves last N stories' elements ordered by created_at DESC
Returns elements grouped by type: {characters: [], settings: [], objects: [], plot_patterns: []}
Each element includes: element_text, embedding_vector, frequency count within window
Query is optimized with proper index usage
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created recentElementsService with getRecentElements function for retrieving story elements from user sessions. Implements database query using idx_story_elements_session_id_created_at index, groups elements by type (character, setting, object, plot_pattern), calculates frequency counts for repeated elements, limits to most recent N stories (default: 10), and includes helper functions getTotalElementCount and getMostFrequentElements. Comprehensive test suite with 17 passing tests. Files: src/services/recentElementsService.ts (352 lines), src/__tests__/services/recentElementsService.test.ts (556 lines).

userStories.title: Implement similarity detection for recent elements
userStories.description: As a system, I need to detect when a new element is semantically similar to recent elements.
acceptanceCriteria: Create findSimilarElements function that takes element text, embedding, and recent elements list
Function compares element embedding against all recent embeddings using cosine similarity
Returns list of similar elements with similarity scores > 0.75 threshold
Results sorted by similarity score descending
Threshold is configurable via parameter (default 0.75)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created similarityDetectionService with findSimilarElements function for detecting semantic similarity between new and recent story elements. Implements cosine similarity comparison using threshold-based filtering (default: 0.75), sorting by similarity score descending. Includes helper functions: findSimilarElementsByType (type-specific search), batchFindSimilarElements (multi-element processing), isNovelElement (novelty check), and getSimilarityStatistics (analytics). Comprehensive test suite with 28 passing tests covering all scenarios and edge cases. Files: src/services/similarityDetectionService.ts (394 lines), src/__tests__/services/similarityDetectionService.test.ts (634 lines).

userStories.title: Create diversity guidance generation service
userStories.description: As a system, I need to generate diversity guidance text to inject into story generation prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create generateDiversityGuidance function that takes recent elements and returns guidance text
Guidance lists recently used elements to avoid with frequency counts
Suggests alternative categories based on what's overused (e.g., if many forests, suggest urban/ocean/desert)
Output format matches template: 'Recently used elements to avoid: ...\nSuggested alternatives: ...\nGoal: Create a story with fresh, unexpected elements'
Function handles empty recent elements gracefully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created diversityGuidanceService with generateDiversityGuidance function for generating natural language guidance to inject into story generation prompts. Implements frequency-based element filtering (threshold: 2+ occurrences), intelligent alternative suggestions based on pattern detection (animals, forests, magic items, etc.), three emphasis levels (subtle/moderate/strong), configurable max elements to list (default: 5), and generateCompactGuidance for token-limited contexts. Comprehensive test suite with 26 passing tests covering all guidance scenarios, alternative suggestions, emphasis levels, and edge cases. Files: src/services/diversityGuidanceService.ts (566 lines), src/__tests__/services/diversityGuidanceService.test.ts (715 lines).

userStories.title: Integrate diversity guidance into story generation flow
userStories.description: As a system, I need to inject diversity guidance into the LLM prompt before story generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify story generation handler to retrieve user session
Before calling story LLM, call getRecentElements for session
Generate diversity guidance from recent elements
Inject guidance into system prompt (append to existing prompt)
Story generation proceeds with enhanced prompt

userStories.notes: Completed: Integrated diversity guidance into story generation flow with non-blocking error handling. Modified StoryRequest interface to include optional sessionId, userId, and storyId fields. Updated storyGenerationService to make buildPrompts async, added getDiversityGuidance helper method that retrieves session, fetches recent elements, and generates guidance. System prompt now includes diversity guidance when available. Files: src/types/story.ts (added fields), src/services/storyGenerationService.ts (327 lines added/modified), src/__tests__/services/storyGenerationDiversityIntegration.test.ts (454 lines).

userStories.title: Implement post-generation element extraction and storage
userStories.description: As a system, I need to extract and store elements after each story is generated.
acceptanceCriteria: After story generation completes, call extractStoryElements on story text
For each extracted element, generate embedding asynchronously
Store each element in story_elements table with session_id, story_id, element_type, element_text, embedding
Process runs asynchronously (doesn't block story delivery to user)
Errors in extraction/storage are logged but don't fail story generation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created postGenerationStorageService with extractAndStoreElements and extractAndStoreElementsAsync functions. Integrated into storyGenerationService with triggerPostGenerationStorage method that fires after successful story generation. Implements non-blocking fire-and-forget pattern, graceful error handling at each step (extraction, embedding, storage), batch embedding generation for efficiency, and optional skipEmbeddings flag. Elements stored with all metadata (story_id, session_id, element_type, element_text, embedding_vector). Comprehensive test suite with 19 passing tests covering all scenarios and error cases. Files: src/services/postGenerationStorageService.ts (309 lines), src/services/storyGenerationService.ts (integration), src/__tests__/services/postGenerationStorageService.test.ts (571 lines).

userStories.title: Create diversity score calculation service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to measure story diversity quantitatively.
acceptanceCriteria: Create calculateDiversityScore function that takes new elements and recent elements
Score formula: (novel_elements / total_elements) * avg_semantic_distance_factor
Novel elements are those with no similar match (similarity < 0.75) in recent elements
Semantic distance factor is average of (1 - max_similarity_score) for each element
Returns score between 0.0 (completely repetitive) and 1.0 (completely novel)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created diversityScoreService with calculateDiversityScore function implementing two-factor formula (novelty_ratio × avg_semantic_distance). Includes calculateElementBreakdown for per-type metrics, convertToScoringFormat helper, classifyDiversityScore (5 categories), and isLowDiversity checker. Handles all edge cases: empty elements, missing embeddings, first story (no recent), multiple similar matches. Comprehensive test suite with 25 passing tests covering all scenarios. Files: src/services/diversityScoreService.ts (368 lines), src/__tests__/services/diversityScoreService.test.ts (797 lines).

userStories.title: Store diversity scores with story metadata
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to persist diversity scores for analytics and monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: After calculating diversity score, store in story_diversity_scores table
Record includes: story_id, diversity_score, novel_element_count, created_at
Low diversity scores (< 0.4) trigger warning log with story_id and score
Storage happens asynchronously after story delivery
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created diversityScoreStorageService with storeDiversityScore function for calculating and persisting diversity scores. Integrated into postGenerationStorageService for automatic storage after element extraction. Implements workflow: fetch recent elements → calculate diversity score → store in database → log warning if score < 0.4. Includes helper methods getDiversityScore and getSessionDiversityStats for analytics. Fire-and-forget async pattern prevents blocking story delivery. Comprehensive test suite with 17 passing tests covering all scenarios. Files: src/services/diversityScoreStorageService.ts (328 lines), src/__tests__/services/diversityScoreStorageService.test.ts (17 tests passing), src/services/postGenerationStorageService.ts (integrated diversity score storage).
